storm.title: 28 June 2024: wettest June day in 88 years
storm.title_hi: 28 जून 2024: 88 साल में जून की सबसे भारी बारिश
storm.note: Hourly shape at Safdarjung reconstructed from IMD's observed totals (228.1 mm in 24 h to 08:30; 148.5 mm between 02:30 and 05:30). Each spot is scaled by distance-weighted 24-hour totals from 10 IMD stations, so rain differs across the city. Gridded reanalysis (Open-Meteo/ERA5) shows only ~24 mm for this day, so observed figures are used.
